Priya: Heads-up: saw regressions after we moved to 64-bit rolling fingerprinting for cache keys; p95 token latencies +18% on longctx. Posting heap + KV cache reuse traces. Anyone seen similar?
Ethan: yikes. can you paste the profile? which change exactly?
Priya: profile: https://perf/internal/175312
Priya: code snippet:
```python
# new keying
key = hash64(tenant_id + ':' + prompt_prefix)
# old: key = tenant_id + ':' + prefix_id
```
Jordan: my hunch: increased key entropy broke locality -> fewer collisions -> smaller hotset hitslice -> more page-ins / eviction thrash. we saw similar with salted tenant ids.
Ethan: Agree. Also our eviction is LRU by slot; more unique keys => fragmentation of KV arrays. We should consider prefix folding (store canonical prefix ids) or a two-tier key: prefix fingerprint + session sticky id.
Priya: I ran a quick experiment: canonicalize first N tokens (prefix_8) + session_tag. p95 down 6% but mem usage up 12% due to extra indirection.
Alex: can you dump the kv map sizes? any change in avg KV length per key? if more small blobs -> fragmentation.
perf-bot: perf-bot: Snapshot uploaded: s3://perf-snapshots/1753129999-kv. Heap diff shows lots of short-lived KV nodes.
Jordan: we might try compacted keying: content-hash(prefix) truncated to 32 bits + tenant, and keep a separate canon table mapping truncated->full to detect collisions. that lowers key cardinality.
Priya: concern: truncated hash -> collisions across tenants. but on hit we can verify full equality and fallback on miss.
Ethan: also look into eviction window tuning: increase residency threshold for session-affine prefixes (lease tokens) so sticky prefixes keep residency during bursts.
Priya: open question: policy API needs to accept 'stickiness: session | request | none' and per-route hints. i'll prototype.
Jordan: :thumbsup: propose A/B: control -> canonicalize prefix_8 -> compact-hash + canon-table. collect per-token pagefaults and kv hitrate.
Alex: i'll set up a perf job with flamegraphs & kv hitrates. ETA EOD.
Priya: thanks — attaching short log sample:
```log
[2026-03-18T09:12:01Z] req=abc tenant=42 prefix_hash=0x1a2b3c kv_hit=false
[2026-03-18T09:12:01Z] req=abc load_kv->evict slot=233
```
Ethan: great. let's minimize churn: keep changes behind runtime_env.FLAGS.kv_rekey_experiment and isolate rollout. kernel selection changes unrelated.
Jordan: sgtm. i'll own rollout monitoring.
Priya: added to thread: @Jordan @Alex @Ethan. will update with experiment results. :eyes:
